Squid rings soaked 30 minutes in buttermilk, dredged in semolina and flour, fried at 190C for 90 seconds. Slice 500g squid tubes into rings and soak in 250ml buttermilk for 30 minutes. Equal parts gin, bitter red aperitif and sweet vermouth stirred over ice, big cube, orange slice. For each drink, stir 30ml gin, 30ml bitter red aperitif and 30ml sweet vermouth over ice for 20 seconds and strain over a big ice cube in a tumbler. Add a slice of orange. Makes four with 120ml of each.

s.note: Squid rings soaked 30 minutes in buttermilk, dredged in semolina and flour, fried at 190C for 90 seconds.
s.how: Slice 500g squid tubes into rings and soak in 250ml buttermilk for 30 minutes. Mix 100g fine semolina and 100g plain flour with plenty of salt. Toss the drained squid through and fry at 190C in batches for 90 seconds. Salt and serve with 2 lemons cut into wedges.

s.note: Fried mozzarella sandwiches in a golden egg and crumb coat.
s.how: Cut the crusts off 8 slices white bread and make 4 sandwiches with 250g sliced mozzarella. Cut each into triangles. Dip in 3 eggs beaten with 3 tbsp milk, then press into 100g breadcrumbs. Shallow-fry in 1cm of oil for 2 minutes a side until golden and the cheese melts.

m.note: Crumbed veal under marinara and bubbling mozzarella, with spaghetti.
m.how: Dust 600g veal escalopes in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 120g breadcrumbs. Shallow-fry 2 minutes a side until golden. Top each with warm passata, 200g sliced mozzarella and 30g parmesan and grill until bubbling. Serve with 400g spaghetti tossed in the rest of the 700ml passata.

w.note: Drained ricotta with icing sugar and orange zest piped into shells at the last minute, chocolate ends.
w.how: Drain 500g fresh ricotta for 2 hours, then beat with 80g icing sugar and the zest of 1 orange. Melt 50g dark chocolate and dip the ends of 8 cannoli shells, then let set. Pipe the filling in just before serving.

d.note: Equal parts gin, bitter red aperitif and sweet vermouth stirred over ice, big cube, orange slice.
d.how: For each drink, stir 30ml gin, 30ml bitter red aperitif and 30ml sweet vermouth over ice for 20 seconds and strain over a big ice cube in a tumbler. Add a slice of orange. Makes four with 120ml of each.
